description: Re-pin — or explicitly justify — KFT's stale plane-version dependencies as part of the KFT 0.4.0 re-ratification. specs/fine-tuning.md's header 'Depends on:' pins KCB 0.2.0, KGP 0.4.0, and KMI 0.2.0 (KINP 0.2.x is current), but the planes have moved: KCB 0.3.0 (candidate — the §2 manifest is now a named A2A AgentCard extension, which changes the very manifest shape KFT §2's `finetune` capability is advertised in), KGP 0.5.0 (candidate — retained canonical + specified RDF projection), KMI 0.3.0 (candidate — OTIO canonical timeline). The stale pins happen to be the LAST-RATIFIED versions of each plane, so this is a real decision, not a typo fix: either (a) track-current — re-pin to 0.3.0/0.5.0/0.3.0 and accept that KFT cites candidate planes, or (b) pin-to-ratified — keep the pins with an explicit justification note naming the current versions and the re-pin trigger (each plane's re-ratification). Whichever way, the header must stop SILENTLY disagreeing with the current plane versions. Spec-edit + changelog discipline per specs/README.md ('How to read a spec': header first; status lifecycle draft->candidate->ratified; each spec carries its own changelog): KFT stays 0.4.0 candidate — this closes a re-ratification precondition, it does not itself ratify. Agnostic: bind roles, no product names. ROADMAP.md Phase 1.
warmup: for s in grounding-pack media-interchange capability-bus identity; do echo "== $s =="; sed -n '1,8p' specs/$s.md; done
verify: python3 -c "import json,glob; [json.load(open(f)) for f in glob.glob('schemas/*.json')]; print('schemas ok')"

userStories.title: Decide the pin policy and apply it to all three stale pins consistently
userStories.description: Choose track-current vs pin-to-ratified for the header 'Depends on:' pins (KCB 0.2.0 -> 0.3.0?, KGP 0.4.0 -> 0.5.0?, KMI 0.2.0 -> 0.3.0?) and apply the same policy to all three — a mixed header (one pin current, another last-ratified, with no stated rule) is exactly the silent disagreement this tasklist exists to end.
acceptanceCriteria: specs/fine-tuning.md's header 'Depends on:' either pins KCB 0.3.0 / KGP 0.5.0 / KMI 0.3.0, or keeps the 0.2.0/0.4.0/0.2.0 pins accompanied by an explicit, in-header (or header-adjacent) justification that names the current versions, states the pin-to-ratified rule, and names the re-pin trigger (the pinned plane's re-ratification) — no pin is left silently stale either way.
The KINP pin (0.2.x, current) is confirmed and left consistent with the chosen policy's spelling (exact-version vs minor-range pinning is stated, not mixed).
The decision's rationale is recorded in the spec's changelog (specs/README.md changelog discipline), citing that the old pins were the last-ratified plane versions.

userStories.title: Reconcile KFT's in-body cross-plane citations with the decided pins
userStories.description: The pins are load-bearing in the body: KFT §2 advertises `finetune` 'in its KCB capability manifest (KCB §2)' — a shape that changed between KCB 0.2.0 (two well-known files) and 0.3.0 (a named AgentCard extension); §4 leans on KGP §7/§7.2 (egress/license/trust); §5 on KMI assets/lineage. Verify each cited section still says what KFT relies on at the pinned version, and annotate where the planes' current candidates change the reading.
acceptanceCriteria: Every cross-plane §-citation in fine-tuning.md (at minimum §2's KCB §2 manifest shape, §4's KGP §7/§7.2 egress gate, §5's KMI asset/lineage conventions, §7's KCB §5 grants) is checked against the pinned plane version and corrected or annotated where the pinned text moved — in particular, §2 states which manifest shape (separate manifest vs AgentCard extension) the pin implies.
No plane contract is re-specified in KFT — citations reference, never restate, per CLAUDE.md ('defined once ... and referenced — never redefined').
If the pin decision was pin-to-ratified, the annotations note where 0.3.0/0.5.0 candidates will change the reading when the re-pin trigger fires, so the next editor inherits the delta list.

userStories.title: Changelog + lifecycle discipline for the re-ratification
userStories.description: Land the edit under koine's spec lifecycle: KFT remains 0.4.0 candidate (this is a dependency-hygiene edit inside the already-open re-ratification, not a new normative fold), the changelog records it, and the pressure-test note reflects that the dep-repin precondition is closed.
acceptanceCriteria: fine-tuning.md's version stays 0.4.0 and Status stays Candidate unless the edit changed a normative clause beyond the dependency pins/citations (in which case the version bumps per the lifecycle — the changelog states which case applied and why).
A dated changelog entry describes the pin decision, the citations reconciled, and its place in the 0.4.0 re-ratification; the 'Last updated' header date moves.

The pressure-test section's re-ratification note (scenarios/e2e-producer-exhaust-finetune.md Re-validation — KFT 0.4.0) is referenced/updated so re-ratification is gated on the scenario re-run alone, with the dep pins no longer an unstated loose end; schemas/*.json still parse.
